wizard_login.title: Wizard: Simplified Credential Extraction
wizard_login.description:
## 🚀 Simplified Guide

The wizard provides you with an **interactive helper page** with automatic validation and copy-paste functions.

### How it works:

1. Open the helper page: [Open Credential Helper](/local/nest_protect/credential_helper.html)
2. Follow the steps on the helper page
3. The page helps you capture and validate the credentials
4. Copy the values and paste them below

### Alternative: Direct Approach

If the helper page doesn't work, you can also enter the credentials directly here. Follow the instructions in the manual method for that.

⚠️ **Important:** Use an incognito window and enable third-party cookies!
